answer: Deposits are visible in umber, and ripple reconciles the forfeits at each close. Because the custody account is separate, an adversary cannot recycle one pool of capital across 175 aliases, and each one needs its own funded ledge account. A bond of 53% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. That bill is paid per identity, so 168 aliases cost 203 times the single-account price. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
